$comment: Input groups for scripts/quality/release-scope-fingerprint.ps1 (S3010). Each group names the tree roots one or more release-scope gates READ. Held as data, not as literals in the script: assert-code-domain-writers.ps1 flags any .ps1 that carries both a write cmdlet and a quoted Code.* path, and the fingerprint writes only temp/ - registering it as a writer would have demanded a domain lock it does not need, while hiding the roots inside expressions would have been obfuscation. As data they are also the vocabulary assert-release-scope-gates.ps1 -OnlyGroups speaks.
